+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21AEPX6A1KRH0TQ0D4QV9CP
+- 01M21ACHJYSF8G8R7HY3M70Z7F
+- 01M21ACSE9JBXMRD2FQQD4CYR6
+position_column: todo

+title: ResponseView and the ContentBlockView family on Textual (plan §4.2, §8, §9 A2, §9 B)
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Content/ResponseView.swift` and `Sources/AgentViewKit/Content/ContentBlockView.swift` with one file per block kind, per plan.md §4.2, §8, §9 A2, and §9 B.
+
+- `ResponseView(message:streaming:)`: renders settled paragraphs through Textual once each (keyed by paragraph id, `.equatable()`), and the streaming tail through Textual with the balanced text. An `.openFence` tail renders through `CodeBlockView` with `appendStreaming`. Applies `EditorKitCodeBlockStyle` with `.textual.codeBlockStyle(_:)`.
+- `ContentBlockView(block)`: switches over the kind and reads `ContentBlockRegistry`. Defaults: `text` through `ResponseView`; `image` with `Image` and a tap that opens the inspector; `audio` through `AudioPlayerView` (AVKit); `resourceLink` through `LinkView` (`LPLinkView` card that opens the URL in the browser, icon from `icons` when present); `resource` as text through Textual or as a file chip for a blob; `attachment` through `AttachmentView`; `structured` through the `StructuredItemRegistry` or the fallback; `unknown` through `UnknownItemView`.
+- A block with `annotations.audience` that excludes `.user` is not rendered.
+- No `WKWebView` anywhere.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A message with three settled paragraphs and a tail renders four Textual views; appending to the tail re-evaluates one.
+- [ ] A fenced block renders through `CodeBlockView`.
+- [ ] A `resourceLink` renders a link card and a tap calls `openURL`.
+- [ ] An assistant-only block is absent from the accessibility tree.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Content/ResponseViewHostedTests.swift`: evaluation counts and fence routing.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Content/ContentBlockViewHostedTests.swift`: one mount per kind, registry override, audience filter.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
